binders: A dimension m, initial-state function Real -> Real^m, and left and right states in Real^m.
conclusions: The data equal the left state on x<0 and the right state on x>0 if and only if there exists a state at x=0 making the entire function equal to the corresponding three-way piecewise function.
mathematical_definitions: piecewise(left,origin,right)(x) is left for x<0, right for x>0, and origin for x=0.
translation.proposition_plain_english: A function has constant left and right states on the two open half-lines exactly when its unrestricted value at the origin can be chosen as a witness so that the whole function is the usual left/origin/right piecewise function.

restrictions_and_vacuity_risks: The value at x=0 is deliberately unconstrained by the left-hand predicate and existentially chosen on the right.
The dimension m may be zero.
No evolution equation, wave solution, flux, or entropy condition is encoded.
